title: Company Schema
description: A company that hires: who it is, where it works and how. Job documents (job-schema.json) point to one through companyUrl

iso8601.description: Similar to the standard date type, but each section after the year is optional. e.g. 2014-06-29 or 2023-04

address.description: To add multiple address lines, use \n. For example, 1234 Glücklichkeit Straße\nHinterhaus 5. Etage li.

countryCode.description: code as per ISO-3166-1 ALPHA-2, e.g. US, AU, IN

region.description: A state or province, for instance

url.description: The company's website, e.g. https://microsoft.com. It identifies the company: job documents name it in companyUrl

logo.description: URL of the company's logo, a square image

description.description: What the company does, in a few sentences

keywords.description: Words that describe what the company does, e.g. ['payments', 'API']

founded.description: When the company was founded, e.g. 2015

employees.description: How many people work there, as a range. Equal min and max for an exact count

stage.description: Funding or ownership, e.g. Bootstrapped, Seed, Series B, Public, Non-profit

locations.description: Offices and other places people work, besides the headquarters

remote.description: The company's usual remote policy; each job document says its own

technologies.description: Languages, frameworks and tools the company uses, e.g. ['TypeScript', 'Postgres']

values.description: What the company says it values, in its words

careers.description: The company's page of open roles

custom.description: Extension data, keyed by tool, as in the resume schema

meta.description: About the document, not the company

canonical.description: URL (as per RFC 3986) to latest version of this document

version.description: A version field which follows semver - e.g. v1.0.0
